rationale: The 4 April 1940 Springfield Weekly Republican page credits illustrations to John O'Hara Cosgrave. The indexed private identifier exactly matches a 1908-born Army entrant classified as a commercial artist, while the distinctive name and occupation align with the University of Southern Mississippi finding aid for John O'Hara Cosgrave (1908-1968). The page supports a documented prewar illustration credit; it does not establish an immediate pre-OSS affiliation.
